summarize_CONFIG: summarize the DaViT-small model configuration for ImageClassifier with GlobalAveragePooling neck and LinearClsHead
review_CONFIG: review the DaViT-small backbone config with arch small out_indices 3 and drop_path_rate 0.2
build_CONFIG: build an ImageClassifier model using the DaViT-small backbone with 1000 class LinearClsHead

refactor_CONFIG: refactor the DaViT-small config to change the LabelSmoothLoss label_smooth_val or mode parameters
